First off welcome, I am ContentProvider and my goal is to provide quality content to /v/uncensored along with Flagger (the moderator). You are welcome to post anything there without fear of edits or censorship as long as it is legal. Now on to why I made this discussion. Many of you came from Reddit, as did I, and you will find that there are differences here which I support fully.

The main difference you will notice at first is that upvoats and downvoats are limited. The limit is directly tied to your contribution to the site. I love this as it prevents people from signing up and just going on a spree of up/downvoats. So the more you contribute to the conversation the more up/downvoats you get. I dont believe in downvoating (neither does Flagger) and personally have pledged to never downvoat anything but how you use the power is up to you. You need 100 contribution points (gained from comments) to downvoat and your upvoates are limited daily by how many contribution points you have.

I really like this system as it helps fight against groups trying to just get things buried or on the front page that they like. It is more of a community effort to bury or front page something here.

Another key difference is you can see how many things people have upvoated or downvoated by looking at their profile. Again I love this as it lets people know who are just trolling with downvoats and who are actually trying to help the community and participate.

Many people think voat is completely censor free and that is not true, the mods on voat can and will moderate their subs as they see fit. I urge you to simply not contribute or subscribe to any sub that you believe has too many harsh rules or a sub that you believe the moderator is censoring.

Last but not least donate if you can, Atko has created this site and needs some help paying for the servers, currently about 50 euro a month but that will go up with popularity. Also feel free to post any questions you have and I will answer if I can. Also feel free to post anything you like to /v/uncensored today for a free upvoat. This is a 24 hour only special and once again welcome and please contribute all the quality material you can to voat. Thanks for reading, Flagger and myself will be keeping an eye out for all you and cant wait to hear what you have to say.
You can ask for upvoats here but that is not what I am doing. I am giving upvoates to anyone that posts in this discussion to get you started. Also, information on how voat works for our new members.

Don't worry

Folk ARPS believe all the best experiences begin with a great community, not a mod-set. We've been providing tactical gameplay without mods, applications or tests since 2010.

Our regular ArmA 3 sessions, played at 19:20 UK on Tuesdays and Sundays, feature 15-35 players with consistent in-game organisation, multi-layered comms and a mix of coop and adversarial missions created by us (most without respawn or revive). Everyone is welcome
